t: Report Re Arrest Of Three Annamite Communists

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 3055
Date 11 / 1 / 32

French Intelligence 7-1-32

Para.14. Arrest of Annamite Communists.
On January 5, members of our section, effected, with the
assistance of the Japanese consular police, the arrest of
Trung Van Lenh, Vuong Trach and Cao Duc Chinh, at the
moment they were embarking the s.s. 'Shanghai Maru' bound
for Japan.
Truong Van Lenh is a very important member of the
Indo-China Communist Party. His arrest is of more interest
than that of Le Quand Dat, effected by our staff on June 5,
1931 (vide our report of June 6, p.3, para.7).
As regards Vuong Trach and Cao Duc Chinh, although
they are unknown to the Political Section, they appear to
be members of the Indo-China Communist Party, under false
names.

Ok. S.B.
Information - The French
Police report that all particulars
regarding these individuals
have been forwarded to you.
S.B.R. 11/1.

Ok S.B.
Translation & report
in question attached.
S.B. 17/1.
S2, I have not received these particulars

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别股登记处
编号：S. B. D. 3055
日期：1932年1月11日

法国情报部门 1932年1月7日

第14段. 逮捕安南共产党人。
1月5日，我处成员在日本领事馆警察的协助下，在Trung Van Lenh（音译）、Vuong Trach（音译）和Cao Duc Chinh（音译）登上驶往日本的“上海丸”号轮船时，将其逮捕。
Truong Van Lenh（音译）是印度支那共产党的重要成员。其被捕比本处人员于1931年6月5日逮捕Le Quand Dat（音译）一事更受关注（参见6月6日报告，第3页，第7段）。
至于Vuong Trach（音译）和Cao Duc Chinh（音译），虽然政治股对他们并不了解，但他们似乎是以化名活动的印度支那共产党成员。

知悉。特别股。
情报——法国警方报告称，关于这些人的所有详细资料已转发给你方。
特别股登记处 1月11日。

知悉。特别股。
所涉译文及报告附后。
特别股 1月17日。
S2，我未收到这些详细资料

Form No. 2
G. 5000-7-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 3055
Station, F 14
Date January 5, 1932.

Subject (in full) Arrest of three Annamite Communist.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [Signature]

At the instance of the French Police the local Japanese
Consular Police arrested three Annamite Communists named Tsang
Yuin Ling (張雲龍) 28, Lee Mong San (李夢山) 24, and Van. Ts
Kwong (范智光) 25, on board the s.s. "Shanghai Maru", berthed
at the N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf, at 8.40 a.m. January 5, 1932, prior
to its departure for Japan.

They were escorted to the Japanese Consulate-General
and subsequently handed over to the French Police.

M. Umemoto.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

(左侧批注：I.R 5.1.32 [Signature])

SI,
Please note in Daily Intelligence
Summary and pass to S2 for further
enquiries.
[Signature] 5/1/32.

(左下角批注：[Signature])

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报 告

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别股登记处
S. B. D. 3055
分局：F 14
日期：1932年1月5日。

主题（全称）：逮捕三名安南共产党人。

制作人：D. S. Umemoto。转呈人：[签名]

应法国警方要求，当地日本领事馆警察于1932年1月5日上午8时40分，在停泊于日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）码头栈桥、即将启程前往日本的“上海丸”号轮船上，逮捕了三名安南共产党人，分别是：Tsang Yuin Ling（張雲龍），28岁；Lee Mong San（李夢山），24岁；以及Van. Ts Kwong（范智光），25岁。

他们被护送至日本总领事馆，随后移交给法国警方。

M. Umemoto.
D. S.

特别股主管警官。

(左侧批注：I.R 1932年1月5日 [签名])

SI，
请在《每日情报摘要》中注明，并转交S2作进一步查询。
[签名] 1932年1月5日。

(左下角批注：[签名])

pages.en:
Translation from French.

Shanghai, January 6, 1932.

BIOGRAPHY OF TRUNG VAN LENH.

The Indo-China Police have no exact information
regarding the identity and antecedents of Troung Van Lenh.
Native of Nghe An, he is believed to have emigrated
to Siam in 1924, in company with Le Nhu Phong.
After several months' stay in that country Troung
Van Lenh and his comrade left Bangkok for Canton.
Upon arrival in Canton on January 27, 1925, Troung
Van Lenh began to take lessons in the Russian language
at the school of the "revolutionary peasants propaganda",
founded by Liao Tchong Hoi, former Civil Governor of
Kwangtung and, at the time in question, head of the
Bolshevist group of the Kuomintang.
In April 1925 Troung Van Lenh left the revolutionary
propaganda school in order to enter the Officers' School
of the Kwangsi Corps.
Following the defeat of General Lau Tchan Wan and
the closure of this school, Troung Van Lenh was admitted
in the Whampoa Cadet School in September 1925.
While studying at Whampoa he contributed articles to
the newspaper "Thanh Nien" (The Youth) since the time of
its first appearance.
After failing to pass his examination at the school,
Troung Van Lenh was appointed corporal in the Garde
Municipale (Canton Police) in August 1926.
In January 1927 he was promoted to the rank of
sergeant and put in charge of 90 men. From that time
he called himself Nguyen Tuan Gam.

7.
pages.zh:
法文译文。

上海，1932年1月6日。

TRUNG VAN LENH（音译）生平简历。

印度支那警方没有关于Troung Van Lenh（音译）身份和履历的确切信息。
他是Nghe An（音译）人，据信曾于1924年与Le Nhu Phong（音译）一同移居暹罗。
在该国停留数月后，Troung Van Lenh（音译）与其同伴离开曼谷前往广州。
1925年1月27日抵达广州后，Troung Van Lenh（音译）开始在“革命农民宣传”学校学习俄语，该校由前广东民政长、当时国民党布尔什维克派系首领廖仲恺（Liao Tchong Hoi）创办。
1925年4月，Troung Van Lenh（音译）离开革命宣传学校，进入桂军军官学校。
随着刘震寰（Lau Tchan Wan）将军战败及该校关闭，Troung Van Lenh（音译）于1925年9月被黄埔军校录取。
在黄埔求学期间，他自《青年报》（Thanh Nien）创刊之初便为其撰稿。
因未能通过学校考试，Troung Van Lenh（音译）于1926年8月被任命为广州市政警卫队（广州警察）的下士。
1927年1月，他晋升为中士，负责指挥90名士兵。从那时起，他自称Nguyen Tuan Gam（音译）。

7.

pages.en:
-2-

His duties did not prevent him from being actively
engaged in the affairs of the revolutionary party and,
in May 1927, he wrote to Ho Tung Mau and Lam Duc Thu who
were imprisoned following Chiang Kai Shek's anti-
communist coup in April, to keep them informed regarding
the current affairs of the party.

At the same time, Nguyen Ai Quoc, prior to his flight
from Canton, entrusted to Troung Van Lenh the task of
entering into relations with the new Cantonese government.
Troung Van Lenh did not waste time and immediately made
successful applications in favour of his imprisoned
compatriots to his Chief and to the Department of Foreign
Affairs. Through the assistance of the chief of the
Canton Police, Troung Van Lenh obtained, in August 1927,
the post of a police company commander, and thanks to
the cordial relations which he maintained with his Chief
the group of the Annamite revolutionaries in that city
enjoyed absolute quietude.

In October (1927 ?) Troung Van Lenh was engaged in the
reconciliation of members of Nguyen Ai Quoc's group with
those of Nguyen Hai Than's. At the end of the same month
he was obliged to resign on account of changes in the
staff of the high administration in Canton, and entered
the service of General Chang Fat Kwai's Army.

In November 1927, he, as well as Ngo Chinh Quoc,
were elected by his comrades to represent Annam at the
meeting of the "Oppressed Peoples League".

If one is to believe his co-partisans, Troung Van
Lenh at that time still possessed influence in Chinese
Military circles in Canton, as he caused the dismissal
from the Whampoa School of Nguyen Hai Tan, who had been
appointed professor and chief of the Annamite cadets by
pages.zh:
-2-

他的职务并未妨碍他积极参与革命党派的事务，1927年5月，他致信在蒋介石4月反共政变后被捕的Ho Tung Mau（音译）和Lam Duc Thu（音译），向他们通报党内的当前事务。

与此同时，阮爱国（Nguyen Ai Quoc）在逃离广州之前，委托Troung Van Lenh（音译）负责与新成立的广州政府建立联系。Troung Van Lenh（音译）没有浪费时间，立即向其上司和外交部成功申请，以利于其被囚禁的同胞。在广州警察局长的大力协助下，Troung Van Lenh（音译）于1927年8月获得了警察连连长的职位，并且得益于他与上司保持的良好关系，该市的安南革命者群体享有绝对的安宁。

1927年10月（？），Troung Van Lenh（音译）致力于调解阮爱国（Nguyen Ai Quoc）派系成员与阮海臣（Nguyen Hai Than）派系成员之间的关系。同月底，由于广州高层行政机构的人员变动，他被迫辞职，并加入张发奎（Chang Fat Kwai）将军的军队服役。

1927年11月，他和Ngo Chinh Quoc（音译）一起被同志推选为代表，参加“被压迫民族联盟”会议，代表安南。

如果相信其同党所言，Troung Van Lenh（音译）当时在广州中国军方圈子里仍拥有影响力，因为他导致阮海坦（Nguyen Hai Tan）被黄埔军校解职，后者曾被张发奎（Chan Fat Kwoi）将军任命为教授及安南学员队长。

pages.en:
-3-

General Chan Fat Kwoi.

In January 1929, when Teng Yuen Hoa, former Chief of
the police, resumed his duties, and Troung Van Lenh was
appointed "Chief of Section" in the police.

He held this post for one month only, during which
time he renewed his applications to the Chinese judicial
and police officials in order to release Hong Son.

At that time it appears that he was engaged in
carrying on secret propaganda among the boys in Shameen,
as he maintained relations with the boy Phan Duc, who was
formerly charged by Nguyen Ai Quoc with the special task
of spreading the "good words" among his comrades in the
French Concession in Shameen.

On February 26, having left his Chief Teng Yuen Hoa,
who had to resign, Troung Van Lenh went to Nanking, via
Shanghai, in company with Le Quang Dat. The object of
that trip was twofold: - 1) to enter in relations with the
Chinese communist leaders who had taken refuge in Shanghai -
such as Teng Yeng Ta and Tan Ming Shan -, in order to
devise a plan of joint action, and 2) to make application
on behalf of Hong Son before the Chinese Government in
Nanking.

In the beginning of June 1928 they were arrested by the
Chinese police in Nanking, but were released almost
immediately, thanks to the intervention of their compatriots -
students of the Military School in that city.

After being appointed a Captain in the Nanking Military
School, Troung Van Lenh accompanied Chiang Kai Shek to
Peking in July. A month later, he visited Canton and,
after a short stay there, returned to Nanking. From this
time on he played a prominent part in the Chinese Communist
pages.zh:
-3-

1929年1月，当原警察局长邓元华（Teng Yuen Hoa，音译）复职时，Troung Van Lenh（音译）被任命为警察局“科长”。

他仅担任此职一个月，在此期间，他再次向中国司法和警察官员提出申请，要求释放Hong Son（音译）。

当时，他似乎正忙于在沙面男孩中进行秘密宣传，因为他与男孩Phan Duc（音译）保持联系，后者此前曾受阮爱国（Nguyen Ai Quoc）委托，承担在沙面法租界向同伴传播“福音”的特殊任务。

2月26日，在不得不辞职的上司邓元华（Teng Yuen Hoa）离开后，Troung Van Lenh（音译）与Le Quang Dat（音译）结伴，经上海前往南京。此次行程有两个目的：1) 与避难上海的中国共产党领导人——如邓演达（Teng Yeng Ta，音译）和谭明山（Tan Ming Shan，音译）——建立联系，以制定联合行动计划；2) 向南京中国政府代表Hong Son（音译）提出申诉。

1928年6月初，他们在南京被中国警察逮捕，但得益于其同胞——该市军校学生——的干预，几乎立即获释。

在被任命为南京军校上尉后，Troung Van Lenh（音译）于7月陪同蒋介石前往北平。一个月后，他访问了广州，短暂停留后返回南京。从此以后，他在中国共产党内发挥了重要作用，而未受到同学或中国当局的干扰，因为他仍保留的警察科长身份使他免受怀疑。然而，他并未忘记Hong Son（音译），并多次提出申请以求其获释。

pages.en:
-4-

Party without being troubled either by his fellow-
scholars or by the Chinese authorities, his rank of the
Chief of Section of the Police, which he still held,
placing him above suspicion. However, he did not forget
Hong Son and made numerous applications to bring about
his release.

In December 1928 Truong Van Benh and Ho Hoc Lam were
elected to represent the Annamite Revolutionary Party at
the 3rd General Congress of the "Oppressed Peoples League".
This congress was held on January 1, 1929 at T'ang Kang
Tse, a place situated at a distance of 300 lis from Dalny.
According to the reports of the French Police of Shanghai,
the Annamites who participated in that congress were certain
Ly Dat Sinh and Luong Hung Chi. Up to the present time
it has not been established whether or not these persons
were Truong Van Benh and Ho Hoc Lam.

Anyhow, Truong Van Benh held during that period an
important post within the "Thanh Kien" Party. Until the
month of May 1929, the date of opening of the "Congress of
the Representatives of Viet Nam", he participated in the
Executive Committee of this Association in the capacity of
a honorary member. But he was not elected when the congress
terminated.

Truong Van Benh was in correspondence with the Prince
Cuong De. In June 1929, the latter expressed to him his
intention of coming to Nankin; to attend Sun Yat Sen's
burial, and asked for the necessary subsidy, but Truong
Van Benh failed to comply with his request, being not in
favour of the Prince's coming to China.

From time to time he participated in the operations
of the 4th Chinese Army in Kiangsi. Hong Son who was
released in December 1929, and who took up the leadership of
the "Tha Nh Nien" Party, succeeded in returning to Nanking
pages.zh:
-4-

1928年12月，Truong Van Benh（音译）和Ho Hoc Lam（音译）当选为安南革命党代表，出席“被压迫民族联盟”第三次代表大会。该大会于1929年1月1日在唐岗子（T'ang Kang Tse，音译）举行，该地位于距离大连300里处。根据上海法国警方的报告，参加该大会的安南人中有确认为Ly Dat Sinh（音译）和Luong Hung Chi（音译）者。截至目前，尚未确定这些人是否就是Truong Van Benh（音译）和Ho Hoc Lam（音译）。

无论如何，Truong Van Benh（音译）在此期间在“青健党”（Thanh Kien，音译）内担任重要职务。直到1929年5月“越南代表大会”开幕之日止，他以荣誉会员的身份参与了该协会的执行委员会。但在大会结束时，他未获选任。

Truong Van Benh（音译）与强㭽亲王（Prince Cuong De）有书信往来。1929年6月，后者向他表达了前来南京参加孙中山葬礼的意向，并请求必要的资助，但Truong Van Benh（音译）未能满足其请求，因为他不赞成亲王来华。

他不定期地参与了江西中国第四军的行动。1929年12月获释的Hong Son（音译）接手领导“青年党”（Tha Nh Nien，音译），并成功返回南京

pages.en:
-5-
where his intervention was necessary in order to obtain
the release of Ho Tung Mau and Le Quang Dat and 15 Annamite
cadets at Whampoa who had been imprisoned by the Cantonese
police, on December 30, 1928 and January 3, 1929. Troung
Van Lenh returned in Naking in June 1929, as a Lieutenant
of the Administrative Service of the 4th Division which was
stationed in cantonment in Honan.

Ho Tung Mau and his associates still being imprisoned,
Hong Son asked Troung Van Lenh to go to Canton in order to take
more active measures for their release, but Van Lenh did not
succeed in getting the necessary permission from his chiefs.
He then decided to flee and after numerous adventures
arrived, on October 20, in Canton where he was received by
Hong Son.

On November 2, he was reported to have left for Outcheou
where it was said, Le Quang Dat found him a place on the
Hoan Viem's General Staff. On the other hand, it was reported
that he embarked at Hongkong on November 22, with his
destination as Saigon.

In December 1930 he was arrested in Hongkong and taken
to Swatow, thence to Canton, where he was sentenced to 9
years imprisonment.

He was arrested in Shanghai on January 5, 1931.
pages.zh:
-5-
在那里，他的干预对于获释Ho Tung Mau（音译）、Le Quang Dat（音译）以及15名在黄埔的安南学员是必要的，这些人曾于1928年12月30日和1929年1月3日被广州警察监禁。Troung Van Lenh（音译）于1929年6月回到南京，担任驻扎在河南营房的第四师行政服务连中尉。

由于Ho Tung Mau（音译）及其同伙仍被监禁，Hong Son（音译）请求Troung Van Lenh（音译）前往广州，采取更积极的措施以释放他们，但Van Lenh（音译）未能从其上司那里获得必要的许可。于是他决定逃跑，经过多次冒险，于10月20日抵达广州，受到Hong Son（音译）的接待。

据报道，他于11月2日前往梧州（Outcheou），据说Le Quang Dat（音译）在那里为他在环维姆（Hoan Viem，音译）的总参谋部谋得一个职位。另一方面，有报告称他于11月22日在香港登船，目的地是西贡。

1930年12月，他在香港被捕，并被押送至汕头，继而转至广州，在那里他被判处9年监禁。

他于1931年1月5日在上海被捕。

reconciliation of members of Nguyen Ai Quoc's group with
those of Nguyen Hai Than's. At the end of the same month
he was obliged to resign on account of changes in the
staff of the high administration in Canton, and entered
the service of General Chang Fat Kwai's Army.

In November 1927, he, as well as Ngo Chinh Quoc,
were elected by his comrades to represent Annam at the
meeting of the "Oppressed Peoples League".

If one is to believe his co-partisans, Troung Van
Lenh at that time still possessed influence in Chinese
Military circles in Canton, as he caused the dismissal
from the Whampoa School of Nguyen Hai Tan, who had been
appointed professor and chief of the Annamite cadets by
pages.zh:
-2-

他的职务并未妨碍他积极参与革命党的事务，1927年5月，他致信在蒋介石4月发动反共政变后被捕的何敦茂（Ho Tung Mau，音译）和林德寿（Lam Duc Thu，音译），向他们通报党的当前事务。

与此同时，阮爱国（Nguyen Ai Quoc）在逃离广州之前，委托张云岭（Troung Van Lenh，音译）负责与新成立的广东政府建立关系。张云岭没有浪费时间，立即向其上司及外交部为其被囚禁的同胞成功提出申请。在广州警察局长协助下，张云岭于1927年8月获得了一个警察连连长的职位，并且得益于他与上司保持的良好关系，该市的安南革命者群体享有绝对的安宁。

10月（1927年？），张云岭致力于调解阮爱国派系成员与阮海臣（Nguyen Hai Than，音译）派系成员之间的关系。同月底，由于广州高层行政人员变动，他被迫辞职，并加入张发奎将军的军队服役。

1927年11月，他和吴正国（Ngo Chinh Quoc，音译）被同志推选为代表，参加“被压迫民族联盟”会议，代表安南出席。

如果相信其同党所言，张云岭当时在广东中国军界仍拥有影响力，因为他导致阮海坦（Nguyen Hai Tan，音译）被黄埔军校解职，而阮海坦此前已被

pages.en:
-3-

General Chiang Kai Shek.

In January 1929, when Teng Yuen Hse, former Chief of
the police, resumed his duties, and Troung Van Lenh was
appointed "Chief of Section" in the police.

He held this post for one month only, during which
time he renewed his applications to the Chinese judicial
and police officials in order to release Hong Son.

At that time it appears that he was engaged in
carrying on secret propaganda among the boys in Shameen,
as he maintained relations with the boy Tran Duc, who was
formerly charged by Nguyen Ai Quoc with the special task
of spreading the "good words" among his comrades in the
French Concession in Shameen.

On February 26, having left his chief Teng Yuen Hse,
who had to resign, Troung Van Lenh went to Nanking, via
Shanghai, in company with Le Quang Dat. The object of
that trip was twofold: - 1)to enter in relations with the
Chinese communist leaders who had taken refuge in Shanghai -
such as Teng Yeng Ta and Tan Ming Chan -, in order to
devise a plan of joint action, and 2) to make application
on behalf of Hong Son before the Chinese Government in
Nanking.

In the beginning of June 1928 they were arrested by the
Chinese police in Nanking, but were released almost
immediately, thanks to the intervention of their compatriots -
students of the Military School in that city.

After being appointed a Captain in the Nanking Military
School, Troung Van Lenh accompanied Chiang Kai Shek to
Peking in July. A month later, he visited Canton and,
after a short stay there, returned to Nanking. From this
time on he played a prominent part in the Chinese Communist
pages.zh:
-3-

蒋介石将军任命为安南学员队的教授兼队长。

1929年1月，前警察局长邓元熙（Teng Yuen Hse，音译）复职，张云岭被任命为警察局“科长”。

他仅担任此职一个月，在此期间，他再次向中国司法和警务官员提出申请，要求释放洪山（Hong Son，音译）。

当时，他似乎正在沙面的少年中进行秘密宣传活动，因为他与少年陈德（Tran Duc，音译）保持联系，而陈德此前曾受阮爱国委派，承担在沙面法租界向同志传播“福音”的特殊任务。

2月26日，在不得不辞职的上司邓元熙离开后，张云岭与黎光达（Le Quang Dat，音译）结伴，经上海前往南京。此次行程有两个目的：1）与避难上海的中国共产党领导人——如邓演达（Teng Yeng Ta，音译）和谭明灿（Tan Ming Chan，音译）——建立联系，以制定联合行动计划；2）向南京中国政府为洪山提出申诉。

1928年6月初，他们在南京被中国警察逮捕，但得益于其同胞——该市军校学生——的干预，他们几乎立即获释。

在被任命为南京军校上尉后，张云岭于7月陪同蒋介石前往北平。一个月后，他访问了广州，短暂停留后返回南京。从这时起，他在中国共产党内发挥了重要作用，

pages.en:
-4-

Party without being troubled either by his fellow-
scholars or by the Chinese Authorities, his rank of the
Chief of Section of the police, which he still held,
placing him above suspicion. However, he did not forget
Hong Son and made numerous applications to bring about
his release.

In December 1928 Truong Van Lenh and Ho Hoc Lam were
elected to represent the Annamite Revolutionary Party at
the 3rd General Congress of the "Oppressed Peoples League".
This congress was held on January 1, 1929 at T'ang Kang
Tse, a place situated at a distance of 300 lis from Delny.
According to the reports of the French Police of Shanghai,
the Annamites who participated in that congress were certain
Ly Dat Sinh and Luong Hung Chi. Up to the present time
it has not been established whether or not these persons
were Truong Van Lenh and Ho Hoc Lam.

Anyhow, Truong Van Lenh held during that period an
important post within the "Thanh Kien" Party. Until the
month of May 1929, the date of opening of the "Congress of
the Representatives of Viet Nam", he participated in the
Executive Committee of this Association in the capacity of
a honorary member. But he was not elected when the congress
terminated.

Truong Van Lenh was in correspondence with the Prince
Cuong De. In June 1929, the latter expressed to him his
intention of coming to Nanking to attend Sun Yat Sen's
burial, and asked for the necessary subsidy, but Truong
Van Lenh failed to comply with his request, being not in
favour of the Prince's coming to China.

From time to time he participated in the operations
of the 4th Chinese Army in Kiangsi. Hong Son who was
released in December 1929, and who took up the leadership of
the "Tha Nh Hien" Party, succeeded in returning to Nanking
pages.zh:
-4-

既未受到同窗的干扰，也未受到中国当局的麻烦，因为他仍保留着警察科长的头衔，这使他免受怀疑。然而，他并未忘记洪山，并多次提出申请以求将其释放。

1928年12月，张云岭和胡学林（Ho Hoc Lam，音译）当选为代表，参加“被压迫民族联盟”第三次代表大会。该大会于1929年1月1日在塘岗子（T'ang Kang Tse，音译）举行，该地位于德尔尼（Delny，音译）以东300里处。根据上海法国警方的报告，参加该大会的安南人中有确认为李达生（Ly Dat Sinh，音译）和梁兴志（Luong Hung Chi，音译）的人。截至目前，尚未确定这些人是否就是张云岭和胡学林。

无论如何，张云岭在此期间在“青健”党（Thanh Kien Party，音译）内担任重要职务。直到1929年5月“越南代表大会”开幕之日止，他以荣誉会员的身份参与了该协会的执行委员会。但在大会结束时，他未获选任。

张云岭与强㭽亲王（Prince Cuong De）保持通信。1929年6月，后者向他表达了前来南京参加孙中山葬礼的意向，并请求必要的资助，但张云岭因不赞成亲王来华，未满足其请求。

他不定期地参与了中国第四军在江西的军事行动。洪山于1929年12月获释，并接任“泰贤”党（Tha Nh Hien Party，音译）的领导职务，他成功返回南京，

pages.en:
-5-
where his intervention was necessary in order to obtain
the release of Ho Tung Mau and Le Quang Dat and 15 Annamite
cadets at Champo who had been imprisoned by the Cantonese
police, on December 30, 1928 and January 3, 1929. Troung
Van Lenh returned in Nanking in June 1929, as a Lieutenant
of the Administrative Service of the 4th Division which was
stationed in a cantonment in Honan.

Ho Tung Mau and his associates still being imprisoned,
Hong Son asked Troung Van Lenh to go to Canton in order to take
more active measures for their release, but Van Lenh did not
succeed in getting the necessary permission from his chiefs.
He then decided to flee and after numerous adventures
arrived, on October 20, in Canton where he was received by
Hong Son.

On November 2, he was reported to have left for Outcheou
where it was said, Le Quang Dat found him a place on the
Hoan Viem's General Staff. On the other hand, it was reported
that he embarked at Hongkong on November 22, with his
destination as Saigon.

In December 1930 he was arrested in Hongkong and taken
to Swatow, thence to Canton, where he was sentenced to 9
years imprisonment.

He was arrested in Shanghai on January 5, 1931.
pages.zh:
-5-
在那里，他的干预对于获释何敦茂、黎光达以及15名在黄埔（Champo，即黄埔）被广东警察于1928年12月30日和1929年1月3日逮捕的安南学员是必要的。张云岭于1929年6月回到南京，担任驻扎在河南营房的第四师行政服务处中尉。

由于何敦茂及其同伙仍被监禁，洪山请求张云岭前往广州，采取更积极的措施争取他们的释放，但张云岭未能从其上司那里获得必要的许可。于是他决定逃跑，经过多次冒险，于10月20日抵达广州，受到洪山的接待。

据报，他于11月2日前往梧州（Outcheou，即梧州），据说黎光达在那里为他在环维姆（Hoan Viem，音译）的总参谋部谋得一个职位。另一方面，有报告称他于11月22日在香港登船，目的地为西贡。

1930年12月，他在香港被捕，并被押送至汕头，随后转往广州，在那里他被判处9年监禁。

他于1931年1月5日在上海被捕。
